---
name: todo-ordering-rule
description: Todo app ordering decision - completed todos below active, insertion order within each group
metadata:
  type: project
---

Decided 2026-09-13 by the user, to keep for the rest of the todo project: completed todos always render below all active todos; within each group, todos stay in insertion order (oldest first). Un-completing a todo returns it to its original insertion position among active ones.

**Why:** Explicit product decision, stated as binding for all later features.
**How to apply:** Any new feature (editing, clear completed, reordering, persistence changes) must preserve this. `todos` array is kept in insertion order; `ordered()` in index.html does a stable partition at render time.
EOF

content.text:
I added completion and filtering to `index.html`. I checked it in headless Chromium: all cases below worked and there were no console errors.

**What changed:**
- **Checkbox:** each todo now has a `todo-toggle` checkbox. Its `todo-item` carries `data-completed="true"` or `"false"`, and done todos are greyed out with a line through them.
- **Filters:** there are three buttons, `filter-all`, `filter-active` and `filter-completed`. "All" is the default. Todos hidden by a filter are left out of the page, not just made invisible.
- **Ordering:** todos are saved in the order they were added. When the list is drawn, active todos come first and completed ones after, each group oldest first. If you uncheck a todo, it goes back to its original place among the active ones.
- **Saved data:** the done state is saved with each todo and survives a reload. Todos saved before this change load as active.
- **Empty message:** if a filter matches nothing, it says "No active todos." or "No completed todos."
- **Styling fix:** the text box style now only applies to the text box, so it no longer affects the checkboxes.

**What I tested:** I added a, b, c and d, then completed b and a. The list showed c, d, a, b, so the completed group kept the order they were added in. Both filters showed the right todos. Unchecking b put it back at the top, and the list stayed the same after a reload.

The filter choice is not saved, so a reload always goes back to "All".

The ordering rule is written as a comment in the code. I also saved it to memory so later sessions keep to it. I haven't committed anything.
